summary: Accept fresh-session restarts with stale or missing handoffs as pending until the seat acknowledges a readable handoff; add a person-only --from-stale-handoff override, keep --now from bypassing acknowledgement, and require the request's own fresh-session launch before completion even if crash recovery replaced the incumbent while waiting.

replay.detail: No historical replay or recovery wait is introduced. Fresh-session restart requests remain runtime.action.requested claims; the optional from_stale_handoff boolean records an explicit person's override on new requests. Existing requests are not rewritten.

schema.detail: Registers the optional boolean from_stale_handoff on runtime.action.requested. No database table, index, migration or numeric schema-version change is introduced.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules version, retention policy or claim-kind change is introduced.

compatibility.detail: POST /v1/agents/restart accepts default-false from_stale_handoff only with fresh_session and a person actor. Fresh-session requests without a current handoff are now accepted as pending, including with now; the CLI returns the pending claim rather than waiting. Older daemons do not implement the acknowledgement-only behavior and may reject missing handoffs or ignore the new field. Use these semantics only through an upgraded API daemon whose seat owner is also upgraded; do not rely on the safety guarantee during mixed-version ownership. Version-pair behavior has not been exercised for this change. Non-fresh restarts and ready-handoff restarts retain their existing behavior.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon deployment restarts still apply; restart-to-API and restart-to-health timing has not been measured. A pending fresh-session request does not force the seat down at its preparation deadline and can wait indefinitely for acknowledgement. An acknowledged or explicitly overridden request replaces the native session as requested.

manual.detail: No automatic data migration or installation repair is needed. For a pending fresh-session restart, have the seat write its handoff or mark it ready after preparation. A person may instead explicitly accept a stale or absent handoff with fractal agents restart AGENT --fresh-session --from-stale-handoff --as person/operator. Inspect the request claim and seat status; --now alone cannot force a fresh-session restart without acknowledgement. See docs/st3/seat-continuity.md.

recovery.detail: Reverting the binaries does not undo a completed native-session replacement or erase an accepted request. Older seat owners can process a pending fresh-session request without the new indefinite-wait guarantee, so resolve pending fresh-session requests before moving ownership back to an older build. Handoff documents, declarations, watches and work remain intact.
